# SocQ Agent Integration Guide

Base REST URL: https://api.socq.ai
Hosted MCP URL: https://api.socq.ai/mcp
Authentication: Authorization: Bearer SOCQ_API_KEY

SocQ exposes a machine-readable Capability Registry at `/v1/catalog`. It contains endpoint IDs, JSON Schema input definitions, normalized output schemas, current billing, availability, documentation links, and generated MCP tool names.

The default MCP connection exposes compact discovery and execution tools. Add `?platforms=youtube,tiktok` to load typed tools for at most five platforms, or `?tools=youtube_comments,x_search` for at most thirty exact tools. Do not combine both filters.

Collection is asynchronous. Submit a request, retain its task ID, and poll until `succeeded` or `failed`. MCP can wait at most 30 seconds per submit call. Request `view=standard` for a fixed, provider-independent resource schema whose declared nullable fields remain present. V1 REST defaults to the compatible `full` view. `fields` supports at most 50 comma-separated top-level or dot-path fields and is valid only with `standard`. Follow `next_cursor` for additional result pages and use the task files endpoint for complete source exports.

CLI examples:

  socq platforms
  socq tools youtube
  socq describe youtube/comments
  socq youtube comments --urls URL --wait
  socq task results TASK_ID --format jsonl --output result.jsonl

Use an idempotency key when retrying a submission after a transport failure. For 24 hours, reusing the key with identical input returns the original task; changing input produces a conflict. Unfinished tasks remain protected until they finish.

See https://docs.socq.ai/llms.json for the complete generated endpoint catalog.

# Snapchat APIs

## Get Snapchat Profiles

Fetch normalized profiles data from Snapchat.

- REST: POST /v1/snapchat/profile
- MCP: socq_snapchat_profile
- CLI: socq snapchat profile

## Get Snapchat Spotlights

Fetch normalized spotlights data from Snapchat.

- REST: POST /v1/snapchat/spotlight
- MCP: socq_snapchat_spotlight
- CLI: socq snapchat spotlight

## Get Snapchat Spotlight Comments

Fetch normalized spotlight comments data from Snapchat.

- REST: POST /v1/snapchat/spotlight-comments
- MCP: socq_snapchat_spotlight_comments
- CLI: socq snapchat spotlight-comments

<!-- input-contracts:start -->
## Input requirements

- `facebook/pages`: Provide public Facebook page/profile URLs in urls. Keyword search, username-only input, and individual post/reel URLs are not supported. Legacy query and usernames fields are ignored when valid urls are supplied.
- `facebook/posts`: Provide public Facebook page/profile URLs in urls. Keyword search, username-only input, and individual post/reel URLs are not supported. Legacy query and usernames fields are ignored when valid urls are supplied.
- `facebook/reels`: Provide Facebook page/profile URLs to collect their reels. A single /reel/... video URL is not a profile URL.
- `instagram/followers-count`: Provide usernames or public Instagram profile URLs. query is ignored and cannot be used as the only input.
- `instagram/reels`: Provide usernames or public Instagram profile URLs. query is ignored and cannot be used as the only input.
- `instagram/search`: query is required and accepts keywords, not task instructions. Separate multiple terms with commas; punctuation such as @, #, quotes, periods, slashes and hyphens is unsupported. results_limit is 1 to 250. urls and usernames are deprecated and ignored.
- `seo/keyword-difficulty`: Choose a supported country and a language available in that country. The defaults are United States (2840) and English (en). Country code 2156 is unavailable here. Locale support differs from Keyword Search Volume and live SERP.
- `seo/keyword-overview`: Choose a supported country and a language available in that country. The defaults are United States (2840) and English (en). Country code 2156 is unavailable here. Locale support differs from Keyword Search Volume and live SERP.
- `seo/keyword-search-volume`: Use language values supported by Keyword Search Volume: Chinese uses zh_CN or zh_TW, not zh. Locale support differs between SEO endpoints.
- `seo/keyword-suggestions`: Choose a supported country and a language available in that country. The defaults are United States (2840) and English (en). Country code 2156 is unavailable here. Locale support differs from Keyword Search Volume and live SERP.
- `seo/keywords-for-site`: Choose a supported country and a language available in that country. The defaults are United States (2840) and English (en). Country code 2156 is unavailable here. Locale support differs from Keyword Search Volume and live SERP.
- `seo/ranked-keywords`: Choose a supported country and a language available in that country. The defaults are United States (2840) and English (en). Country code 2156 is unavailable here. Locale support differs from Keyword Search Volume and live SERP.
- `seo/related-keywords`: Choose a supported country and a language available in that country. The defaults are United States (2840) and English (en). Country code 2156 is unavailable here. Locale support differs from Keyword Search Volume and live SERP.
- `seo/relevant-pages`: Choose a supported country and a language available in that country. The defaults are United States (2840) and English (en). Country code 2156 is unavailable here. Locale support differs from Keyword Search Volume and live SERP.
- `seo/search-intent`: Use the language codes declared for this endpoint. Locale support differs from Keyword Search Volume and live SERP.
- `tiktok-shop/product`: This endpoint currently supports US only. Omit region or set it to US; other regions are rejected before task creation.
- `tiktok-shop/user-showcase`: This endpoint currently supports US only. Omit region or set it to US; other regions are rejected before task creation. results_limit must be 20 to 2000.

Explicit no-posts responses from instagram/hashtag-posts and linkedin/search-posts complete with empty results; other failures are preserved.
<!-- input-contracts:end -->

# Discovery, community and ad APIs

## TikTok Popular Creators

Discover popular public TikTok creators with audience and follower filters.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok/popular-creators
- MCP: socq_tiktok_popular_creators
- CLI: socq tiktok popular-creators
- Billing: Per returned result

Optional creator filters; results_limit defaults to 20 and accepts integers from 1 to 2000.

## TikTok Popular Songs

Discover popular or surging TikTok songs and their sound clip IDs.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok/popular-songs
- MCP: socq_tiktok_popular_songs
- CLI: socq tiktok popular-songs
- Billing: Per returned result

Optional song filters; results_limit defaults to 20. time_period accepts the ranking options 7, 30 and 130. Boolean filters must be JSON booleans.

## TikTok Top Search

Search public TikTok videos and photo carousels.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok/top-search
- MCP: socq_tiktok_top_search
- CLI: socq tiktok top-search
- Billing: Per returned result

query is required. results_limit defaults to 100. Results can contain videos and photo carousels; region changes content availability and does not guarantee geographic filtering.

## TikTok User Live

Check public TikTok accounts for live streaming status, including offline results.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok/user-live
- MCP: socq_tiktok_user_live
- CLI: socq tiktok user-live
- Billing: Per returned result

Provide a non-empty usernames array. Each successful lookup returns one billable status, including is_live=false for offline accounts.

## Reddit AD Library Search

Search public Reddit ad inspiration with creative, industry and objective filters; up to 30 ads.

- REST: POST /v1/reddit-ad-library/search
- MCP: socq_reddit_ad_library_search
- CLI: socq reddit-ad-library search
- Billing: Per returned result

query is required. results_limit defaults to 30 and accepts integers from 1 to 30. Search returns at most 30 ads; additional collection pages are unavailable.

## Reddit AD Library Ad

Get a public Reddit ad creative by its ad identifier.

- REST: POST /v1/reddit-ad-library/ad
- MCP: socq_reddit_ad_library_ad
- CLI: socq reddit-ad-library ad
- Billing: Per returned result

Provide ad_id from Reddit AD Library Search.

## X Community

Get public X community metadata, member counts, rules and membership policies.

- REST: POST /v1/x/community
- MCP: socq_x_community
- CLI: socq x community
- Billing: Per returned result

Provide public X community URLs in urls, using /i/communities/{numeric_id}.

## X Community Posts

Collect public posts from X communities in creation-time order.

- REST: POST /v1/x/community-posts
- MCP: socq_x_community_posts
- CLI: socq x community-posts
- Billing: Per returned result

Provide public X community URLs in urls. results_limit applies to each URL, defaults to 100, and must be a multiple of 20 between 20 and 2000.

## X Thread Context

Collect the target X post, its ancestors and replies while preserving thread relationships.

- REST: POST /v1/x/thread-context
- MCP: socq_x_thread_context
- CLI: socq x thread-context
- Billing: Per returned result

Provide X post URLs in urls. results_limit applies to each URL, defaults to 100, and accepts integers from 1 to 2000. Results retain the target post and its thread relationships.
